title: C# Exception Filters
description: Automatically exclude selected exceptions from C# exception breakpoints in every workspace.

title: Medieval 2 Synax
description: Language extension for working with Medieval 2: Total War text files

title: Nifty Snippets: Snippets & File Templates
description: Snippets and file templates with live values: dates, UUIDs, file and folder names, git user and branch, prompts and pick lists, with case transforms like PascalCase and kebab-case.

title: Nifty Macros: Record & Replay Keystrokes
description: Record typing and cursor moves and replay them any number of times, or define named macros that chain commands, text and snippets, each bindable to a key.

title: Nifty Undo Tree: Local History & Undo Branches
description: Never lose an edit to undo again: every version of a file is kept in a tree, including branches you undid and typed over, with diffs and one-click restore.

title: Nifty Containers: Podman, Docker & Apple Container
description: One container view for Podman, Docker, nerdctl and Apple's container CLI: start, stop and remove containers, follow logs, open a shell, inspect, and clean up images.

title: Nifty Helm & Kustomize: Values IntelliSense
description: Helm .Values IntelliSense (completion, hover, go to definition, missing values) and Kustomize navigation, checks with quick fixes, an overlay tree, patch target hovers, build previews and diffs.

title: Nifty HCL Tools: .tf and .hcl Language Support
description: Fast, lightweight Terraform and OpenTofu support: highlighting, outline, go to definition and references across a module, hovers, completion, undefined-reference errors and formatting.

title: Nifty Nginx: nginx.conf Formatting & IntelliSense
description: nginx config support: syntax highlighting, formatting, directive completion and docs on hover, context checks, and snippets for reverse proxies, SSL and PHP.

title: JoJoX — Sicurezza per codice AI
description: Controlla il codice mentre scrivi: gli stessi 40 controlli di sicurezza del sito jojox.it, senza LLM e senza inviare nulla fuori dal tuo editor.

title: AISDLC Companion
description: Human interface for AISDLC forges: connect your services, start a forge for a ticket, and follow the agents and repositories of the forge.

title: Delta Builder for sfdx-git-delta
description: Build Salesforce delta packages between two git refs with a guided form for `sf sgd source delta`. Built on sfdx-git-delta, the SGD plugin created by scolladon.
